verdict.rationale: Amplitude explicitly documents server-to-server HTTP APIs, an Experiment API for managing flags/experiments 'from CI, scripts, or your own tools', data export/Dashboard REST APIs, and a published OpenAPI spec, all enabling headless, scriptable automation without UI interaction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of CI pipelines actually using these APIs, and no dedicated headless CLI mode beyond the interactive Wizard CLI.
